blockers: Eight medium-severity CodeQL alerts are reported in code changed by PR #62 and have not yet been individually triaged or resolved.
next_actions: Inventory likely security-sensitive sinks in changed Python files.
Map each CodeQL alert to file, line, rule and dataflow before remediation or false-positive disposition.
Patch true positives with least-privilege/fail-closed controls and add negative tests.
Re-run CodeQL and require zero unresolved medium/high/critical alerts before merge.
claims_boundary: A successful CodeQL check run does not mean zero vulnerabilities. The current CodeQL output explicitly reports eight new medium-severity alerts in changed code, so this gate blocks merge until those alerts are triaged and resolved or independently justified as false positives.
